summary: Americold Realty Trust filed an 8-K to report entry into an Amended and Restated Syndicated Facility Agreement, which amends its prior credit facility. The agreement increases and extends maturities on various tranches: a $1.15B revolving credit facility (maturing June 2030), a $375M term A-1 loan, a CAD$350M term A-2 loan (increased by CAD$100M, maturing June 2031), a new AUD$230M term loan, and delayed draw term loans. Proceeds were used to repay revolving borrowings; remaining funds for general corporate purposes. No special situation is present as this is a routine refinancing of credit facilities.
